name: Rock Paper Scissors
summary: Two-player zero-sum hand game where rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, and paper beats rock.
rules_text: Two players simultaneously choose one of rock, paper, or scissors. Choices are revealed at the same time. Rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, paper beats rock. If both players choose the same symbol the round is a tie. In a single-round version a tie is a draw; in a repeated version tied rounds are replayed or scored as zero until a winner emerges. The winner is determined solely by the pair of gestures according to the cyclic dominance rules.
rating_reason: Classic simultaneous zero-sum game, fits payoff_matrix
